Name: Better Dying Grandpa Redux- CP
Author: Faedelity
Description:
This Content Patcher pack replaces the graphics for Grandpa's scene in the intro to a new game, to allow him to sit in a dignified manner in a study rather than lie in a rickety-looking cot apparently moved to be closer to the fire. There are also a couple of cute Easter Eggs Matty put in, which are on by default, but can be turned off if they conflict with other mods (not likely, but I figured it would be good to give everybody a choice).

The Config file will be generated when you run the game with the mod active for the first time. If you want to turn off the Easter Eggs, just run the game, then close it, change "true" to "false" in the config, and you're set.

Pretty much a fire-and-forget mod that just gives Grandpa a bit more dignity when you start a new game.

Downloads.Description: The main mod- just unzip into your Mods folder with Content Patcher, and you should be good to go.
